name: Checkpoint mid air walljump: a wall cling's wall coyote carried through a quick restart
techNote: A floor, a wall on the right (x 300-400) and a ledge on the left (x -900 to -200, top y 290) with the finish box on it; the respawn point is at standing height at x 0 (an ordinary checkpoint). Jump right into the wall and cling (tick 24: OnWall, wallCoyoteFrames 7), then quick restart on input 25: Movement.respawn zeroes Velocity and momentum and sets onGround, but leaves wallCoyoteFrames 7 and wallJumpsLeft; on the ground it doesn't count down. Jump straight up on input 28 (wallCoyoteFrames then counts 6, 5, ...) and press again with left on input 34 (wallCoyoteFrames 1): getPlayerControlledInput takes it as a wall jump off no wall (jumpBuffer && wallCoyoteFrames > 0, before the double jump; WJ only here): Velocity (-460, 730) away from the way the dot faces (still right, from the cling), wallJumpsLeft 4 -> 3, from y 142.9. It peaks 292 u above the floor against a plain jump's 258 and lands on the ledge, finish on tick 66. `no-cling` (the same inputs after standing instead of clinging) and `late` (the second press on input 36, the count run out) are plain jumps that hit the ledge's face.

ghosts.label: Cling, quick restart, jump, jump again 6 ticks later: a wall jump off no wall
No cling before the restart: the second press does nothing
The second press 8 ticks after the jump: the wall coyote ran out
